summary: Release v0.3.8 with agent capacity, review lifecycle, and attributed finish evidence
description: Publish the shipped agent-team-derived capacity policy, separate work/review lifecycle, and runtime/billing/usage finish attribution as an immutable stack release so go-project-template can adopt the behavior truthfully.
acceptance: R-1: Runtime, package, and repo-local project versions are consistently 0.3.8/v0.3.8.
R-2: Changelog and operator docs describe capacity planning, review lifecycle, and attributed finish evidence without claiming subscription usage is invoice cost.
R-3: Local release checks and the complete stack test gate pass at the final release commit.
R-4: Annotated v0.3.8 and the release commit are pushed and remotely verifiable.

R-5: Existing-tag validation starts from a root-managed committed launcher, reconstructs the exact remote annotated-tag payload without mutating the caller checkout, and fails closed against environment, executable-path, Python user-site, Git-config, helper, hook, fsmonitor, uploadpack, index-flag, and alternate-worktree injection.
